name: oh-my-bb
description: Independent BB plugins maintained by Hemanth Soni.

plugins.description: Keep coding when a Claude or ChatGPT account reaches its limit. Route Claude Code, Codex, omp, FX, nanocodex, Prime Agent, and Pi (including Hempi and agent profiles) through ordered accounts and optional API-key fallbacks. Translate Messages and Responses requests when a fallback uses another protocol. FX, nanocodex, and Prime Agent require their separate optional adapters; routed FX and Prime Agent need no local provider login. Claude Max accounts are restricted to Claude Code; API-key fallbacks bill per token. Optional Jev routing sends the truncated last user message and candidate model names to OpenRouter.

Publish versioned pages in project folders, browse them in BB, ask questions with forms, and share them securely. Chart support bundles Highcharts; users must obtain and manage their own Highcharts license.

Receive webhooks from PostHog, Slack, and other services, and turn them into thread messages, new threads, or automation runs. Supports Standard Webhooks signatures (as PostHog sends), Slack request signatures, and bearer tokens. Automation runs use their saved prompt; payload fields are not forwarded. Needs a public HTTPS route to one path on your BB server.
